note: Owner 2026-11-25: authored trajectories, statistics not checks, semantic functional programming, runtime function synthesis through NL literals. One check admits; every other item is a statistic the wave report compares with its target (scripts/rl_tasks/sources/authored_programs.py TARGETS) and feeds into the next wave's EMPHASIS.md.

check.statement: The program is a complete natlang package: `natlang check --json` reports no errors.

Each instance's authored trajectory replays through the runtime with no model to a finished root call: every call below the root is answered by an entry, every action runs (or fails as the instance's expected_failures declares), every value has its declared type.
An instance that declares an rl oracle returns a value its oracle accepts.

statistics.statement: TypeScript logic lines are a small share of the program: exact work lives in eval code where it is short, and in a listed, justified helper only where it is long or reused.
The NL call tree is deep: root, interior functions with callable folders of their own, leaves.
Several functions compose other natural-language functions.

The trajectories use many kinds of semantic-FP construct: map, filter, reduce, iterateOn with a measure or an NL check, structural recursion, folder reducers, decisions, ensures, refinements, higher-order functions, NL literals.
Functions are values: passed, bound with .partial or .in, returned, iterated.
Functions are synthesized at run time: NL literals whose instructions are built from the program's data.
A real share of the call tree runs through NL literals.
Many calls write open text: summaries, replies, rewrites, plans, explanations.
Calls are natural-language calls, not crisp helper calls.
